title: CausalOps Graph Constraints & Structural Priors
description: System-knowledge constraints defining allowed, forbidden, and uncertain causal edges across microservices and variables. Prevents statistical causal discovery from generating physically implausible relationships.

allowed_directed_edges.mechanism: HTTP client requests propagate downstream load and traffic surges
Synchronous HTTP order verification calls propagate load
Synchronous HTTP payment processing calls propagate load
JDBC SQL queries propagate load to database engine
Database query latency delays JDBC client completion, elevating inventory latency and connection pool use
Inventory processing latency or errors cause order service caller to block or receive 500 error
Payment failure or latency causes order service caller to block or fail order transaction
Order service delay or failure elevates gateway client-facing latency and error rates

forbidden_directed_edges.reason: ORTHOGONAL_BRANCH: No network connectivity, shared process, or application dependency exists between database and payment service.
ORTHOGONAL_BRANCH: Payment service has zero access or interaction with inventory database.
ORTHOGONAL_BRANCH: Sibling branches beneath order-service do not communicate directly.
ORTHOGONAL_BRANCH: Sibling branches beneath order-service do not communicate directly.
SKIP_LEVEL_SHORTCUT: Order service does not connect to database directly; all interactions mediate through inventory-service.
SKIP_LEVEL_SHORTCUT: Physical architecture requires mediation through inventory-service and order-service.
SKIP_LEVEL_SHORTCUT: Gateway communicates only with order-service; inventory-service is an internal tier-2 dependency.
SKIP_LEVEL_SHORTCUT: Gateway communicates only with order-service; payment-service is an internal tier-2 dependency.
SKIP_LEVEL_SHORTCUT: Direct downstream calls from gateway bypass order orchestration logic.
SKIP_LEVEL_SHORTCUT: Direct downstream calls from gateway bypass order orchestration logic.
SKIP_LEVEL_SHORTCUT: Gateway has no database connection pool.

uncertain_directed_edges.description: Whether severe order-service queue backup creates connection pool backpressure into inventory-service under heavy retry loops
Whether severe order-service timeouts trigger repetitive client retries flooding payment-service

forbidden_edge_rules.reason: anomaly_score is a deterministic mathematical transformation of latency and error_rate; it cannot causally affect raw telemetry.
Temporal delta x(t) - x(t-1) is a mathematical difference, not an exogenous driver of the underlying level.
Physical causality respects the thermodynamic arrow of time; future states cannot cause past states.
db_latency is strictly zero/null on non-database microservices in CausalOps.

engineering_priors: Network routing isolation between orthogonal branches
learned_observational_relations: Cross-service time-lag coefficients discovered during Phase 3B discovery algorithms
